## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #195, exact head `ec5f4c65b9b01ac2dda2316e3227e55c25a38a98`.

Reviewed the complete `bac14b2..ec5f4c6` delta and directly dependent atomic-store flow. The stale-qualification mark is source-repaired, and no new exploitable vulnerability was identified. Prior authority/rendering qualifications remain.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new vulnerability identified | - |

`NudgeWork` is built from filtered holdings, claims and holder-grouped request IDs, not caller-supplied JSON (`crates/daemon/src/idle_nudge.rs:228-299`). Typed arrays are bound into one INSERT...SELECT; its EXISTS branches require actual open rows: same seat/project/role/instance holding, same seat/project/kind/number claim, or same request ID with holder equal to target, delivered and unanswered (`crates/store/src/idle_nudges.rs:93-125,253-294`).

Live-idle and own-sequence vetoes remain in the statement. Owned writes use BEGIN IMMEDIATE, and sending follows only a committed insertion; refusal or query failure cannot authorize a nudge/FYI (`crates/store/src/migrate.rs:47-56,267-274`; `idle_nudge.rs:132-159`).

The regression separately ends each sole qualifying item between due and mark while retaining a bare holding, then asserts no mark/message/FYI (`crates/daemon/src/idle_nudge_tests.rs:783-841`). Indexed-plan assertions are present, but were not locally executed.

Numeric and F-item instances share the nine-ASCII-digit bound without integer parsing/overflow (`crates/core/src/idle_nudge.rs:33-56,113-139`). Clear/Busy-only sending and guarded notice rendering remain; `receipt_label(false)` accurately labels spared cold seats (`idle_nudge.rs:347-430`; `idle_nudge_tests.rs:756-769`).

Remaining limits: same-key reassignment legitimately qualifies; one surviving named item suffices, so other snapshot labels can be stale. All-label-per-prime FYIs and existing assignment/claim authority are unchanged. Post-mark/send and cold-check/send windows remain non-atomic; this is not race-free delivery.

No migration or new C19/C21 disclosure was identified. GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42528102748` and latest successful Delivers run `42528113683` both identify this SHA and success; the earlier cancelled Delivers run is superseded.

No local builds, tests, probes, qualification operations, credential reads or mutations were performed. Claimed mutant results were not repeated.
